observations.conglomerate: Rounded/subrounded clasts can be flattened and differently exposed, held within continuous finer matrix. Yellowstone image supports a broad exposure range; Florissant view is distant and partly occluded, no size measurement claimed. Six-clast depth trial is a style comparison, not correction of proved structural failure.
observations.horsetail: Fine branches radiate from stem nodes, with differing directions, lengths and upward posture. Retain segmented stem/whorls; do not convert to broad fern leaves or impose a modern species reconstruction.
observations.modern_scope_limit: Modern E. arvense reference supports genus-level form only. Existing two unbranched cone shoots are not copied as modern species or added to branched shoots; cone/stem colors and counts remain the prior stylized concept.
